system.description:
You trap and bargain with souls — the dead are a resource, their knowledge a currency. Information flows from the other side to those who know how to ask.

  • Soul Snare
  • Once per encounter, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP or below, you may bind its soul briefly
  • The bound soul must answer one question truthfully before passing on — the answer comes as a whisper only you can hear — after answering, the bound soul may impose disadvantage on one enemy's next attack roll or save.
  • Whisper of the Dead
  • Advantage on Speak with Dead checks and all checks involving souls, spirits, or planar entities
  • Once per day, ask a recently dead creature (dead no longer than 1 day per Necromancer level) one yes/no question — no spell slot required
